descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for: 
 We are seeking an experienced Embedded Cryptographic Software Engineer to join a team focused on developing security-critical software and cryptographic solutions for embedded platforms. You will contribute to the design, implementation and verification of cryptographic software, working on both traditional and Post-Quantum Cryptography, as well as protection mechanisms against physical attacks.
 What you will do: 
Develop, optimize and maintain cryptographic software for embedded platforms using C, Assembly or Rust.
Implement cryptographic algorithms and security features based on defined requirements.
Develop software countermeasures against physical attacks, including Side-Channel Analysis and Fault Injection.
Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews and implementation reviews.
Debug software issues, perform root-cause analysis and support problem resolution.
Collaborate with firmware, operating-system, platform and testing teams to ensure secure integration and software quality.
Maintain technical documentation and support product certification and security evaluation activities.
 What you need to have: 
A Bachelor's or Master's degree (or PhD) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Cryptography, Engineering or a related technical field.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in cryptography, embedded security or secure software development.
Good knowledge of cryptographic algorithms such as ECC, RSA, AES, SHA-2 and SHA-3.
Hands-on experience with embedded software development in C.
Understanding of microcontroller architectures, particularly ARM Cortex-M or RISC-V.
Experience with Assembly programming is highly desirable.
Knowledge of Side-Channel Analysis, Fault Injection countermeasures or Post-Quantum Cryptography is an advantage.
Experience with Rust is a plus.
Strong debugging, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with distributed engineering teams.
Good English communication skills.
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package.
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills.
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit.
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things;
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do;
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
